features: 'PACKED WITH ORGANIC INGREDIENTS - A superior combination of organic dry oils extracted from amaranth, olive, macadamia, avocado, argan, rosehip and grapeseed for a combination of naturally sourced vitamins, antioxidants and bio flavonoids to penetrate rapidly without a greasy after feel. The serum replenishes squalene which is a naturally occurring lipid in human skin that naturally depletes with age.', 'BENEFICIAL FOR ALL SKIN TYPES - Can be used on all skin types but most beneficial for dry to normal skin above age 35. We do not believe in animal testing and all of Dr. Denese products are manufactured under FDA-mandated procedures. Our goal is to give you an exceptionally high percentage of the key ingredients.'
